objective: Standard statement: for a connected cubic triple system H with three distinct points per line that is not 2-colourable, prove (1) the approved grammar (Fano blocks, splices, odd cycles) is incomplete: the twisted cube gives a 43-point counterexample; (2) structure of the tight-cut decomposition of B(H): every piece is a cubic bipartite multigraph; a brace with a parallel pair has at most four vertices (the triple edge or the doubled square); every parallel pair in a piece has a contracted endpoint, so doubled squares have at least two contracted vertices and every leaf is a simple cubic brace whose induced signing is trivial except possibly one negated edge at its contracted vertex; every brace is Pfaffian, hence (Robertson-Seymour-Thomas) the Heawood graph, a doubled square, or built from planar braces by 4-sums; (3) the one-twist lemma (no cubic brace has a Pfaffian signing with exactly one negative edge) for planar braces, the Heawood graph and 4-sums of two planar braces cubic at the seam, and the Fano-leaf theorem it implies (every leaf is a Fano block, so every such H other than the Fano plane contains at least two Fano blocks); (4) the converse: a planar cubic bipartite connector with a signing satisfying Kasteleyn's face parity, with Fano blocks at its doubled incidences and twisted pieces at its negated edges, yields non-colourable systems (twisted cube, odd cycles). Nearest known result: Robertson-Seymour-Thomas 1999; Vazirani-Yannakakis 1989; Kasteleyn; McCuaig 2000; THREEFOLD-SPACES-20261030-001. Classification: to be decided.
status: Proved: the approved grammar is incomplete (twisted cube, 43 points, has the cube as a brace); every leaf of the tight-cut decomposition is a Fano plane minus a line or a point (one-twist lemma for all braces via the Robertson-Seymour-Thomas trisum structure and a 4-cycle partner lemma), so every three-fold space other than Fano holds two Fano pieces; every planar cubic bipartite graph is the core of three-fold knot spaces (decoration).
title: Fano leaves and planar glue
